properties.notes: Former police station and adjacent office buildings within Prudhoe town centre. The buildings are now surplus to requirements following closure and ae standing vacant. Offers opportunity for a conversion scheme. Two applications for redevelopment have been permitted in 2018 potentially enabling development of 9 flats in total. An application for alteration and conversion of the police station to a veterinary surgery and conversion of former office buildings to create 4 flats has been permitted (18/02051/FUL). An associated application for the alteration conversion of the police station to create 5 dwellings has also been approved (18/02504/FUL). Both proposals are supported living units (C3) providing specialist residential accommodation for vulnerable individuals. Whilst extra support will be provided to residents, these are self-contained flats that constitute as separate dwellings. Either proposal could be delivered, or a combination of the two. As a result, the final yield from development could be 4, 5 or 9 flats on completion, depending on whether the veterinary surgery element is progressed. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion in the next 5 years.
